event_data.context: The portable clock passed all 107 tests with each local backend. Review found the prior trigger could persist in a database with the current schema. Replacing the trigger on every migration and verifying a database retaining the prior expression resumes across fresh appends.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the testing tools, examples, and parity verification capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Testing tools, examples, and parity verification
